messages:
maria: Quick heads-up 1 1 we must finalize the driver/CUDA/ROCm matrix for the OEM marketplace bundle before handing artifacts to AcmeAccel. They need pinned versions for their compliance review.

kai: Are we doing a single certified combo or offering certified + compatible variants?

maria: Certified combo for OEM image; compatible variants can be published but not included in the certified bundle.

sanjeev: Note: ROCm 5.6 has a scheduling regression under heavy concurrency (INF-2891). Recommend we certify ROCm 5.5 and mark 5.6 experimental.

emily: Marketing needs the exact pinned list to draft the partner one-pager and the announcement caveat.

noah: Suggest we pin kernel to 5.15.0-101 (LTS) and include kernel git hash in metadata to avoid ambiguity. Also list container base (ubuntu:22.04).

maria: Draft certified stack: kernel=5.15.0-101, base=ubuntu:22.04, nvidia-driver=535.86.10, cuda=12.1, cudnn=8.9.2, rocm=5.5. Marketplace tag: acme-oem-certified-20260314.

acme-eng: Acme requests a signed contact for expedited hotfixes and a 24h heads-up requirement.

sanjeev: For INF-2922 (small-batch streaming memleak) patch may need a kernel rebuild. If patch lands late, we'll hold kernel and publish a note; otherwise we rerun canaries and flip the certified tag after 48h of green canaries.

partners-bot: ACTION: upload cert-matrix to partner-artifacts and update partner-compat-matrix link.

noah: I'll add preflight checks to the marketplace validator to reject images if metadata and actual kernel/driver mismatch. Also will create two tags: certified and compat-12.2. Deploy bot will only change default after staging + 2-day canary.

deploy-bot: INFO: created INF-2924 (image-tagging + preflight) and scheduled staging canary.

emily: I'll deliver the one-pager and partner-facing caveat by EOD Friday.

maria: Action items: @noah image tags + preflight (INF-2924). @sanjeev canary tests + land/fail patch (INF-2922). @emily partner one-pager. Meeting to finalize Thu 9am PT. Thanks all. :heavy_check_mark:
